name: zfmv_action_flip_surfaces
description: zFMV_Action::FlipSurfaces drives the accepted zVideo surface-present path with null source/destination rectangles and wait/blit flags enabled.
known_limits: The smoke patches the zVideo dependency and verifies the wrapper call contract; zVideo::AdjustSurfacesIfEnabled behavior is accepted separately by target zvideo_adjust_surfaces.
tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV action/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x462f00 validates a thin wrapper that calls zVideo::PresentOrAdjustSurfacesIfEnabled/AdjustSurfacesIfEnabled with null source and destination rectangles and stack flags waitForPresent=1 and blitPrimaryToSwFirst=1, then returns.
The native smoke patches zVideo::AdjustSurfacesIfEnabled, calls zFMV_Action::FlipSurfaces, and verifies one dependency call with null rectangles and both flags set to 1.
